sections.content: HTML email is a strange cousin of web HTML: email clients strip <style> blocks, ignore most modern CSS, and require table-based layouts for reliable rendering.
Inline styles are mandatory, images need absolute URLs, and interactive elements mostly fail. The golden rule: test in real clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail) because they all render differently.
Key points: tables for layout, inline CSS only, alt text on every image, and keep the width near 600px.
